# Easy BACnet
A free Android app that scans a building network for BACnet/IP devices, reads their points, and exports a CSV; plus plain-English BACnet field guides.

## Guides
- What is a BACnet points list?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/what-is-a-bacnet-points-list.html
- How do I find my BACnet points list?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/how-to-find-your-bacnet-points-list.html
- A vendor asked for my BACnet information &mdash; what do I send them?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/vendor-asking-for-bacnet-information.html
- Why can't I find my BACnet devices when I scan?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/why-cant-i-find-my-bacnet-devices.html
- Why is my BACnet point stuck, and how do I release an override?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/bacnet-priority-and-stuck-overrides.html
- What do the BACnet object types mean?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/bacnet-object-types-explained.html
- What is a BACnet Device ID, and why do duplicates matter?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/bacnet-device-id-explained.html
- How do I use Easy BACnet to get a points list off a building?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/how-to-use-easy-bacnet.html
- How do I write to a BACnet point with Easy BACnet, and release it afterwards?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/how-to-write-to-a-bacnet-point.html
- How do I build a custom remote for a BACnet device in Easy BACnet?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/how-to-build-a-custom-remote.html
- The app can't find what I'm looking for — what do I do?: https://easybacnet.com/guides/cant-find-what-im-looking-for.html
- Easy BACnet home: https://easybacnet.com/index.html
- Privacy policy: https://easybacnet.com/privacy.html
